title: Brown Bears Eat 30 Salmon a Day and Top 1,000 Pounds

scenes.text: A single brown bear can eat 30 salmon in one day.
Every summer, bears in Alaska's Katmai National Park gorge on the salmon run.
They have only a few months to build enough fat to survive winter.
A big male weighs 600 to 900 pounds in midsummer, and well over 1,000 by fall.
Then he hibernates for months without eating or drinking, and loses a third of his weight.
The 2025 Fat Bear champion, Chunk, was estimated at 1,200 pounds.

description:
Brown bears at Katmai National Park can eat as many as 30 salmon in a day, and big males top 1,000 pounds by fall.
They lose about a third of that weight while hibernating.
Which bear gets your vote?
first_comment: Which bear gets your vote for the fattest of all time?
